service_outputs.description: early warning point and settlement-centre anchor

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected immediately when founding a camp or replacing a destroyed centre. Fails when flooded, smothered, out of fuel or unsafe from nearby fire hazards.

required_inputs.description: bedding and optional ground mat or heating fuel

behaviors.failure_rules: Chosen during founding, migration, disaster or temporary labour surges. Becomes strained when overcrowded, damaged, wet or seasonally unsuitable.

service_outputs.description: temporary repair supply and construction progress feedback

behaviors.failure_rules: Required in the POC before staged NPC construction. Fails when stock is inaccessible, markers are buried/blocked, ownership is invalid or the active project moves beyond practical hauling range.

service_outputs.description: triage or registration capacity and reduced homelessness pressure

behaviors.failure_rules: Triggered by migration, disaster, labour recruitment or housing loss. Penalised if kept as long-term housing without upgrades.

service_outputs.description: household assignment and improved climate protection

behaviors.failure_rules: Required when camp residents need permanent homes. Fails if roof, access, beds or climate protection are invalid.

service_outputs.description: local tool storage and reduced travel time to fields/barn

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when agriculture is important and worker travel is high. Underperforms without nearby productive parcels.

service_outputs.description: efficient heating and communal meal support

behaviors.failure_rules: Useful under rapid population growth, limited land or communal culture preference. Morale may fall if imposed on privacy-focused cultures.

required_inputs.description: Household provisions plus workplace inputs defined by the attached shop/work module

service_outputs.description: active streets and reduced travel demand

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when land value, street activity and mixed-use demand rise. Can fail through incompatible hazards, noise or blocked private access.

service_outputs.description: efficient land use and district population support

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected under urban housing pressure and limited parcels. Becomes unsafe or low-morale when services, exits or maintenance fail.

required_inputs.description: water access or rainfall and optional fertiliser

behaviors.failure_rules: Required when provisions fall below reserve targets. Can lie fallow through season, crop rotation or labour shortage rather than being “broken.”

required_inputs.description: repair materials and optional fertiliser or mana support

service_outputs.description: Higher or more reliable crop output
specialty crops and reduced drought/slope penalties

behaviors.failure_rules: Chosen for food pressure, poor flat land, drought risk or agricultural specialisation. Pauses if water rights or network capacity fail.

service_outputs.description: farm-tool access and reduced spoilage/weather loss

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when farm storage, animals or harvest handling are bottlenecks. Fire, pests and feed shortage are key failure risks.

service_outputs.description: project/emergency reserve separation and clearer provision forecasting

behaviors.failure_rules: Required at Village when food production exceeds safe household storage or seasonal reserve targets rise. Fails through moisture, pests, fire or untracked access.

service_outputs.description: social mealtime and reduced foodborne-risk when operational

behaviors.failure_rules: Required when settlement grows beyond household cooking or raw-food dependence becomes unsafe/inefficient. Pauses from fuel, water, cook or ingredient shortage.
Selected when grain surplus and kitchen/bakery demand justify processing. Stops cleanly on blocked output or lost power.
Selected for food variety, trade, morale or population demand; not a required survival building if communal kitchen capacity is sufficient.
Selected for seasonal surplus, long routes, winter risk or trade. Can create health risk if sanitation, temperature or recipe control fails.

service_outputs.description: manure/by-products and transport or farming capacity

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when owned animals lack capacity or transport/farming demand rises. Welfare and escape risk worsen if overcrowded or underfed.

service_outputs.description: trade goods and optional transport access

behaviors.failure_rules: Only eligible when local water and ecology support it. Overfishing, storms, pollution or hostile water creatures can reduce output.

required_inputs.description: fuel/light and optional herbs or magical components

service_outputs.description: medicine crafting or dispensing and health reassurance

behaviors.failure_rules: Required when population, injury history or stage expectations exceed informal care. Becomes overloaded when patients exceed staff/beds/medicine.

service_outputs.description: outbreak detection and emergency response support

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when healer hut is overloaded, district access is poor or threat/industry raises injury load. Fails through staff, medicine, sanitation or access shortage.

Selected when city population, travel distance, casualty history, disease risk or specialist demand exceeds clinics. It underperforms when staff, medicine, water, sanitation, access or clean separation fail.

service_outputs.description: safe evacuation capacity and reduced outbreak/disaster spread

behaviors.failure_rules: Triggered by outbreak, refugee arrival, disaster warning, damaged housing or event requirement. Dormant when not needed and should not consume heavy staffing.
Selected for morale, identity, story or governance need. Should not penalise cultures whose equivalent is a grove, plaza or ancestor house.

required_inputs.description: cleaning supplies and optional trade goods

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected under visitor, trade, morale or meal-capacity demand. Can increase noise, crime or fire risk if poorly managed.
Selected when town density, clinic needs, culture or sanitation pressure justify it. Does not become a mandatory personal need meter.
Selected for morale, culture, tourism or event requirements; remains useful between events as public space.

required_inputs.description: fuel for cremation where used and optional offerings

service_outputs.description: safe body handling and cultural continuity

behaviors.failure_rules: Triggered by deaths, cultural requirements or memorial events. Lack of an accepted rite can prolong morale penalties, but not every culture needs graves.
Selected after basic needs stabilise or when culture/story/tourism demands rise. Provides little benefit if permanently unstaffed or inaccessible.

service_outputs.description: may also reserve seed stock or mark protected trees

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when timber demand exceeds imports or casual gathering. Output falls when the zone is depleted, unsafe, inaccessible, overprotected or lacks tools/hauling.

required_inputs.description: mechanical/fuel/water power where required and recipe knowledge

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when building demand, timber waste or carpenter bottlenecks justify it. Pauses with no logs, dull/broken blades, blocked output, lost power or unsafe machinery.

required_inputs.description: repair supplies and optional blasting or magic permits at later tiers

behaviors.failure_rules: Eligible only where usable stone exists. Selected for sustained construction demand; output falls with exhausted faces, unsafe slopes, tool shortage, blocked hauling or flooding.

service_outputs.description: salt or related raw material plus rejects and washed grades

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when local material demand and deposit quality justify operation. Flooding, contamination, depleted layers, unstable walls or no hauling can pause it.

required_inputs.description: repair materials and optional pumps or ventilation

service_outputs.description: cave resources and underground route access

behaviors.failure_rules: Only eligible with useful underground resources or strategic access. Can pause after collapse, flooding, gas, hostile occupation, missing supports, no tools or blocked hauling.

service_outputs.description: Large volumes of ore and stone
survey data and strategic underground access

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when shallow sources cannot meet demand and technology, specialists, capital and safety capacity exist. Major incidents can close levels without destroying the whole complex.

required_inputs.description: labels and optional water or mechanical separation

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when ore volume, grade variation, smelter efficiency or trade value justify it. Blocked bins, absent sorters or contamination reduce benefit.

service_outputs.description: fuel stock and possible wood vinegar/tar at advanced variants

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when fuel demand, winter risk or smithing grows. Fire, rain, wood shortage, blocked storage or unattended burns can interrupt production.

required_inputs.description: optional mechanical or mana power and any realm-specific protective supplies

service_outputs.description: unstable residue and occasional rare catalysts according to the resource definition

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when a known deposit, mage specialist and sustained mana demand justify the risk. It pauses or degrades when the node is exhausted, unsupported, contaminated, inaccessible, overloaded or legally restricted.

service_outputs.description: survey depletion data and optional rare finds

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when manual extraction cannot meet verified demand and the settlement has power, maintenance and safe logistics. It pauses on depleted reserve, no power, blocked output or unsafe instability.
Required by Village stage or an equivalent building-component provider. Pauses with no timber, missing tools, blocked output, no carpenter or unsafe machinery.

service_outputs.description: carved blocks and rubble or by-products

behaviors.failure_rules: Required for sustained stone construction or equivalent imported supply. Pauses with no stone, broken tools, blocked heavy access or unsafe stockpiles.
Required by Village stage unless trade reliably supplies tools and repairs. Pauses without a smith, fuel, metal, tools, safe ventilation or output capacity.

service_outputs.description: storage containers and ceramic trade goods

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when storage containers, tiles, brick demand or cultural trade justify it. Firing can fail with wet wares, wrong fuel, poor skill or a damaged kiln.
Selected for clothing resilience, sacks and logistics, morale or culture goods, uniforms or trade. Pauses with missing fibre, tools, patterns, staff or blocked outputs.
Selected when hides and leather demand justify cost. Health penalties can arise from failed drainage, contamination, overcrowded vats or poor separation.
Selected when urban construction, windows, laboratories, bottles or trade justify it. Can be disabled by fuel shortage, a damaged furnace, unsafe heat, no specialist or blocked cooling and output.
Selected when metal demand, machine production, defence or megaprojects exceed village smithy capacity. Output pauses safely when buffers, cooling, fuel or staffing fail.
Selected when the settlement owns several machines, suffers repair delays or unlocks advanced automation. It underperforms without specialist skill, precision tools, power or component stock.

service_outputs.description: residue and occasional failed/junk outputs under risky recipes

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when a trained specialist, rune knowledge, mana supply and demand for enchanted equipment exist. It can shut down on instability, impurity, ward failure or illegal recipe use.
Selected when local surplus, shortages, population or visitor demand justify trade. Empty stalls provide no stock; theft, weather, blocked routes or no vendors reduce service.
Selected when a viable route, surplus, shortage or diplomatic opportunity exists. Pauses when routes are unsafe, stock unavailable, permissions revoked or storage blocked.
Selected when stall congestion, trade volume and town population justify a permanent hall. Service degrades with empty vendors, poor logistics, crime, sanitation or blocked access.
Eligible only on active caravan or coach routes. Demand falls if routes shift; raids, disease, feed shortages or no secure storage reduce use.

required_inputs.description: secure communications and member stock guarantees

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when city trade volume, routes and merchant population justify coordination. Corruption, insolvency, war or broken communications can reduce trust and contract access.

required_inputs.description: maintenance and curriculum or knowledge access

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when population, children, literacy needs, specialist succession or culture priorities justify it. No teacher or materials means no active service, though the room can host community lessons.

service_outputs.description: reduced hiring dependency and unlocked vocational recipes

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when missing specialists, an aging workforce, unemployment or growth creates succession demand. Training slows without masters, tools, practice stock or linked jobs.

required_inputs.description: climate or fire protection and cataloguing labour

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when knowledge stock, research, literacy and town governance justify it. Fire, moisture, theft, corruption or absent staff can damage access and collections.

required_inputs.description: power/mana where relevant and funding or patronage according to governance

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when the city has stable basic needs, enough students and specialists, research demand and sustained resources. It can fail through faculty loss, archive damage, political restriction, unsafe research or insufficient utilities.

required_inputs.description: meeting supplies and linked profession data

service_outputs.description: reputation and culture or faction identity

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when enough workers and contracts exist to justify organisation. Empty membership or no linked profession provides little benefit; political conflict can split or suppress guilds.

required_inputs.description: maintenance supplies and optional treasury or notice-board stock

behaviors.failure_rules: Required for normal Village-stage administration unless a validated culture-specific equivalent exists. Pauses services if no recognised leader or clerk, public access is blocked, records are destroyed or ownership is disputed.

required_inputs.description: lighting and service information from districts

service_outputs.description: elections or succession events where the governance profile supports them

behaviors.failure_rules: Triggered when population, district count, project volume, laws or public services exceed Village Hall capacity. Underperforms when offices are vacant, records fragmented, treasury inaccessible or districts disconnected.

Selected when district count, population, service complexity and regional authority exceed the Town Hall. It becomes strained when staff, records, communications, public access or political legitimacy fail.

service_outputs.description: heritage records and reduced planning conflicts

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when parcel conflicts, project backlog, district complexity, census uncertainty or blueprint volume causes Infrastructure strain. Fails when records burn, staff are absent, ownership data conflicts or archive capacity is exceeded.

required_inputs.description: guard support and basic detainee provisions where holding is used

service_outputs.description: reputation effects and lawful escalation to exile

behaviors.failure_rules: Conditional on crime/dispute volume, formal laws, population and faction expectations. Does not operate without a recognised authority, law profile, staff, reports or valid evidence/witness process.

service_outputs.description: trade statistics and political or reputation consequences

behaviors.failure_rules: Triggered by route value, taxation law, faction border, smuggling pressure, conquest or trade volume. Fails without authority, staff, route traffic, secure storage or clear tariff rules.

service_outputs.description: warnings and diplomatic incidents remembered by the world

behaviors.failure_rules: Conditional on sustained faction contact, treaties, visitors, regional importance or conflict mediation. Underperforms without envoys, interpreters, security, hospitality or recognised diplomatic status.

required_inputs.description: ceremonial or cultural goods and hospitality stock

service_outputs.description: emergency-command fallback and high-value political events

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when governance profile, population, diplomacy or culture expects an official residence. Becomes a raid, coup or protest target if security, legitimacy or public access is poorly managed.

service_outputs.description: story access and regional crisis coordination

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected after capital status, stable governance, diplomacy and major supply chains. Failure can involve legitimacy crisis, occupation, archive loss, faction conflict, siege or incomplete ceremonial commitments.

service_outputs.description: approved project records and builder task packages

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when player blueprints, project count, parcel conflicts or construction backlog become meaningful. Pauses approvals if no planner, records, map data, permissions or validated submission interface.

service_outputs.description: gate support and visible security presence

behaviors.failure_rules: Required at Village stage where threat settings are active. Fails with no guards, equipment, safe route, authority or patrol links; overloaded coverage creates slow response rather than invisible protection.

service_outputs.description: livestock or civilian separation and visible breach points

behaviors.failure_rules: Required in the POC only where the village defence plan calls for a perimeter; otherwise equivalent terrain or cultural defences may validate. Fails through gaps, low terrain clearance, disconnected gates, fire damage or blocked evacuation.

service_outputs.description: curfew or permission enforcement and incident reporting

behaviors.failure_rules: Required with the POC palisade. Fails if no perimeter connection, road is blocked, mechanism cannot operate, guards cannot reach positions or permissions lock residents inside.

service_outputs.description: improved skill/readiness and organised patrol shifts

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected after repeated raids, guard shortages, population growth or military policy. Underperforms without captain/trainer, gear, valid training space, provisions or patrol connections.

service_outputs.description: civilian confidence and visible breach/repair state

behaviors.failure_rules: Triggered by Fortified Village growth, strategic wealth, repeated siege threats or political borders. Fails through disconnected sectors, inaccessible patrols, unstable foundations, blocked gates or insufficient maintenance.

service_outputs.description: equipment condition tracking and reduced loss or theft

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when guards exist but equipment readiness is low, stock is dispersed or raids justify reserves. Fails without quartermaster permissions, real stock, secure access, safe storage or repair support.
Selected when threat, border, route, wealth or political control justifies it. It is costly and can increase raid value, fear, occupation pressure or maintenance burden.
Selected when density, flammable materials, industry, disasters or incident travel time create Safety pressure. Fails without trained crew, water, tools, alarm, route access or maintained equipment.

required_inputs.description: fuel or mana where required and maintenance

behaviors.failure_rules: Triggered by siege risk, storms, floods, magical instability, population density or prior casualties. Fails if the hazard profile is wrong, exits block, supplies expire, ventilation fails or capacity is falsely claimed.
Triggered by scattered stock, spoilage, theft, project delay or household overflow. Underperforms when full, wet, damaged, unlabelled, inaccessible or permissions block intended users.

required_inputs.description: repair materials and optional security equipment

service_outputs.description: category alerts and trusted automation input/output

behaviors.failure_rules: Required for normal Village project reservation. Fails or degrades when full, understaffed, looted, burned, permissions conflict, loading is blocked, categories are contaminated or save ledger state is invalid.

required_inputs.description: pest control and optional power/temperature inputs

service_outputs.description: safer hazard separation and reduced warehouse pressure

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when one category repeatedly fills general storage, spoils, creates danger or limits production. Fails when wrong stock is inserted, safety separation is invalid or maintenance is ignored.
Selected when city warehouses are full, hauling labour is excessive, districts starve despite surplus or trade throughput is blocked. Pauses safely on power or output failure by default.

service_outputs.description: patrol connection and visible settlement organisation

behaviors.failure_rules: Required for the POC access graph. New paths are selected when key entrances are disconnected or travel cost is excessive. Mud, flood, obstruction and unsafe slope reduce service.

service_outputs.description: safer public streets and lower haul labour

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when dirt routes fail under weather/load, carts are blocked or critical crossings create risk. Damage, flooding, collapsed supports or blocked gates break continuity.
Conditional on water route value. Selected when water reduces travel or unlocks trade. Fails with blocked approach, unsafe water, damaged berth, no staff, route danger or disconnected road.

service_outputs.description: limited farming/livestock support and emergency firefighting reserve

behaviors.failure_rules: Required at Hamlet unless a valid culture/biome equivalent exists. Fails when dry, contaminated, collapsed, blocked, frozen without adaptation or access is unsafe.
Selected when wells are strained, drought risk is high, districts lack access, fire reserve is low or production requires water. Weakest-link faults reduce output.

required_inputs.description: fuel/power where used and repair stock

service_outputs.description: cleaner streets and safer dense settlement growth

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when density, markets, livestock, rain, disease or industry creates Health/Infrastructure pressure. Fails through blockage, overflow, no collection labour, contamination leak or unsafe disposal.

required_inputs.description: repair stock and optional ward/conduit components

service_outputs.description: research hints and community magical services

behaviors.failure_rules: Conditional on mage arrival, magical discovery, reputation, culture or player action. It remains dormant without a valid specialist or safe mana stock.
Selected when a trained alchemist, reagent supply and medicine/magic demand exist. Risky recipes may be restricted by law, reputation or world settings.

required_inputs.description: tuning tools and optional signal or watchtower link

service_outputs.description: protected routes or structure shielding according to the ward profile

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected after repeated magical/creature threats, corruption exposure or cultural ritual demand. It becomes dormant when mana is empty, runes are damaged or ownership changes.

required_inputs.description: Mana crystals/shards/dust or other accepted fuel

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when intermittent mana supply, wards or machines need reliable power. It degrades with impurity, overcharge, damaged containment, theft or incompatible fuels.
Selected by culture, story, threat, research or major event. It should not run automatically without a valid ritual project, resources and participants.
Selected when city population, specialists, research demand, culture and mana infrastructure support it. It loses output when faculty, archives, mana or safety fail.
Selected after magical injuries, corruption exposure, cultural demand or story events. It cannot solve every illness and may require rare reagents or cooldowns.

required_inputs.description: maintenance parts and regional access rights

service_outputs.description: regional project unlocks and controlled high-capacity mana transfer

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected after regional mana demand or anomalies justify the cost. It can create political conflict over strategic energy and must not provide infinite free mana.

required_inputs.description: ward power and optional realm fuel

service_outputs.description: trade and emergency evacuation according to permissions

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected after portal knowledge, destination anchor, city infrastructure, political permission and stable mana exist. It closes on destination danger, instability, attack or insufficient power.
Selected after stable realm access, repeated anomalies or capital research goals. High maintenance and political risk prevent routine early construction.

service_outputs.description: educational demonstrations and early automation components

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when copper mechanisms are unlocked or hauling/processing bottlenecks appear. It remains useful for cheap, reliable and emergency manual systems.

required_inputs.description: repair parts and optional storage/buffer mechanisms

service_outputs.description: water pumping or direct machine drive
with variable output and source telemetry

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when terrain provides a reliable source and machines need sustained power. Output varies with season/weather and pauses on obstruction or structural damage.
Selected when ore supply and metal demand justify local processing. It stops on no fuel/power, blocked output, unsafe heat, damaged chamber or unstable mana.
Selected when a repeated processing chain creates labour or yield pressure. The planner avoids duplicate mills without distinct demand or module role.
Selected when routes intersect, hauling labour is high or storage/production has persistent blocked flow. It pauses safely when destinations are full.

service_outputs.description: grid telemetry and emergency reserve when buffered

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when renewable/manual power cannot meet sustained demand. It creates maintenance and fuel demand and should shut down before normal overload becomes catastrophic.

service_outputs.description: research data and reduced labour per unit

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when food demand, climate, land scarcity or specialist crops justify capital and utility cost. It fails on water, power, disease, blocked output or climate-control loss.
Selected when city demand and supply chains justify scale. The planner penalises a factory without stable inputs, power, output markets or maintenance labour.
Selected after research, materials, law and sustained labour need. It must not make named NPCs irrelevant and may create unemployment, fear, faction or rebellion consequences.

service_outputs.description: emergency shutdown and regional planning data

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected only after a capital has multiple networks whose unmanaged failures or competition create regional risk. It adds coordination, not raw generation.

service_outputs.description: by-products and visible rural settlement identity

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when provisions demand, suitable land and workers justify a coordinated rural cluster. It adapts or rejects sites with poor soil, unsafe distance, no water or route conflict.
Selected when dispersed trade, public requests and civic travel need a shared centre. It becomes strained through crowding, blocked deliveries, poor sanitation, unsafe routes or insufficient storage.
Selected when production buildings compete for land, routes and utilities or hazards threaten mixed settlement areas. It is rejected if staffing, logistics, buffers or waste handling are impossible.
Selected when housing demand, travel distance or unplanned sprawl requires coordinated parcels and services. It can remain low density where culture or terrain prefers it.

service_outputs.description: siege resilience and visible city identity

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when city value, threat, faction conflict or strategic position justifies major defence. High cost, maintenance and political symbolism prevent it from being an automatic stage requirement.

service_outputs.description: teaching/recovery environment and coherent institutional identity

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when one anchor complex is constrained by land, support services, traffic or future expansion. It is not required merely because the city owns a clinic or school.

service_outputs.description: trade growth and reduced long-distance hauling

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected when trade, travel and freight are blocked by disconnected terminals, repeated transfers or warehouse congestion. It is conditional on genuine regional routes and demand.

service_outputs.description: story access and major political consequences

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected only after capital governance, stable energy, specialists, district infrastructure and story/faction gates. Costs require automation, contracts, trade and long-term construction.

service_outputs.description: unusual housing/industry and access to high-altitude or floating content

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected only when metropolis density, technology/magic, air routes or story goals justify extreme cost and risk. Failure may force evacuation, controlled descent, isolation or catastrophic regional events under severe conditions.

service_outputs.description: story progression and a persistent world landmark

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected through capital status, culture story, major research, rare materials and political consensus or conquest. Rival factions may support, sabotage, contest or attempt to claim it.

service_outputs.description: spare-capacity potential and positive morale when maintained

behaviors.failure_rules: Selected for permanent housing growth, replacement of huts or family formation. Loses contribution when overcrowded, damaged or inaccessible.

required_inputs.description: maintenance materials and accessible patrol support

service_outputs.description: signal events and reduced surprise during raids

behaviors.failure_rules: Required in the POC defence loop and selected when scouting, raids or blind approaches create Safety pressure. Fails if sightlines are blocked, access is unsafe, no guard or signal exists, or damage disables the platform.
